title: Obligations & Violations in Reports
goal: Report institutional duties and violations using compound and modal ser passives

items: I can form compound and modal ser passives in human-rights reports while keeping participle agreement.
I can keep sido invariable while matching the main past participle to the subject in gender and number.
I can use due-process, ratification, and impartiality vocabulary in C1 institutional prose.
